definitions: A process supported by various tools, technologies, and contracts involving the generation and management of digital representations of physical and functional characteristics of places.
A digital representation of physical and functional characteristics of a facility.

An intelligent 3D model-based process that gives architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) professionals the insight and tools to more efficiently plan, design, construct, and manage buildings and infrastructure.
examples: Building Information Modeling is transforming the construction industry.
Our firm specializes in Building Information Modeling services.
Understanding Building Information Modeling is crucial for modern architects.
